affected_subject.reason: Identifies Positions.deposit in BasePositions.sol and its maxAmount0/maxAmount1 parameters.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete flow: deposit calls updatePosition, beforeUpdatePosition hook moves sqrtRatio/tick, then debt recalculated at new price.

direct_effect.reason: Final debt exceeds original maxAmount and user is forced to supply more tokens than authorized.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual relation: maxAmount acts as contractual slippage limit that final debt violates.

summary: Report explains affected deposit function, the hook-induced price move trigger, the resulting excess token debt, and the violated maxAmount slippage limit, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
